ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark-gray/black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white ring-shaped (annular) blobs varying in diameter from 5-15 pixels, densely populated across the distal and medial regions of both lobes against a uniform dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and a depth of approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels; more pronounced jaggedness observed on the inner-half of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge of the right lobe; left lobe exhibits a more linear trajectory towards the tip with a slight terminal convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive high-density spatial distribution of circular/donut-shaped white pixel clusters (barnacle scars) covering over 50% of the visible fluke surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches and significant trailing-edge erosion located on the inner margin of the left lobe adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme density and uniformity of the annular 'donut' scar patterns across the entire ventral surface constitute a highly unique visual signature.
